name: no-sleep-waiting-on-subagents
description: Never sleep or poll while a background subagent runs; react to the completion notification.

interface.shortDescription: React to subagent notifications instead of sleeping.
interface.longDescription: Bans sleep loops and polling while background subagents run: the harness notifies on completion, so the agent keeps working and reacts when the notification arrives, launching synchronously only when nothing can proceed without the result.
defaultPrompt: Keep working while the background agent runs.
Stop sleeping in a loop waiting for that subagent.
Launch it synchronously if you need the result now.
